description: A shell script for configuring and managing a web interface to git repositories, supporting various web servers and embedded server configurations.

methods.name: resolve_full_httpd
methods.description: Resolves the full path to the HTTP server executable based on configuration.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Starts the configured web server, handling process management and configuration.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the running web server by killing its process.

methods.name: httpd_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if the web server has started and is listening on the specified port.

methods.name: configure_httpd
methods.description: Configures the web server based on the specified server type.

methods.name: python_conf
methods.description: Sets up a standalone Python HTTP server with CGI support for gitweb.

methods.name: lighttpd_conf
methods.description: Creates configuration for the Lighttpd web server.

methods.name: apache2_conf
methods.description: Creates configuration for the Apache2 web server.

methods.name: mongoose_conf
methods.description: Creates configuration for the Mongoose web server.

methods.name: plackup_conf
methods.description: Creates a standalone PSGI server script for gitweb using Plack.
